name: Freyjanaut
body:
Freyjanauts, also known as Freyja’s Chosen, are the elite commanders of the Champions of Freyja. Only a handful of people in the world bear this title. They are all leaders within Freyja’s cult and each controls a large faction.

Freyjanauts bear an indomitable spirit and unwavering dedication to Freyja. Guided by the goddess of love, beauty, and war, these warriors walk a sacred path, embracing both the artistry of diplomacy and the intensity of battle. Clad in armor adorned with symbols of Freyja’s prowess, they strive to bring harmony, protect the innocent, and fiercely defend the divine will of their beloved goddess. Through their resolute devotion, the Freyjanauts forge a bond with Freyja that intertwines their destinies, transforming them into extraordinary champions, the epitome of grace and strength on the battlefield.

Background. Freyjanauts are chosen by Freyja herself, their souls touched by her divine favor, for they embody the virtues of fierce independence, sensuality, and unyielding determination. These warriors hail from diverse backgrounds, drawn together by their shared reverence for the radiant and captivating deity.

Raised amidst tales of valor and magic, they undergo rigorous training in martial skills, imbued with Freyja’s essence that infuses their every movement.

Freyjanauts always have a long and distinguished history with Freyja’s cult. They have served as acolytes, initiates, and champions for many years. As a result of this history, they have deep connections within the cult and the extended community.

Adventures. As cult leaders, Freyjanauts concern themselves only with the most important issues. A Freyjanaut may take matters into her own hands when the cult is threatened or when the goddess herself requires it.

Requirements

To qualify to become a Freyjanaut, a character must fulfill all the following criteria.

Base Attack Bonus: +6
Skills: Knowledge Arcana 8 ranks, Knowledge Religion 8 ranks
Feats: Any one Metamagic Feat
Special: Discerning Listener, Divine Flesh, Seducer’s Senses, and Show of Nonaggression class abilities
Class Skills

The Freyjanaut’s class skills are Craft (Int), Diplomacy (Cha), Heal (Wis), Intimidate (Cha), Knowledge (arcana) (Int), Knowledge (local) (Int), Knowledge (religion) (Int), Linguistics (Int), Perception (Wis), Perform (Cha), Profession (Wis), Sense Motive (Wis), and Spellcraft (Int).

Skill Ranks at Each Level: 4 + Int modifier

Hit Die: d10

Table 2: The Freyjanaut
Level	Base Attack	Fort	Ref	Will	Special	Spells per Day
1	+1	+1	+0	+1	Divine flesh +1, lay on hands, universal communicator	+1 level of existing class
2	+2	+1	+1	+1	Divine flesh +1 use/day	+1 level of existing class
3	+3	+2	+1	+2	Blindsight, divine flesh +1	+1 level of existing class
4	+4	+2	+1	+2	Perfect strike	+1 level of existing class
5	+5	+3	+2	+3	Object of desire, divine flesh +1	+1 level of existing class
Class Features

The following are all features of the Freyjanaut.

Universal Communicator (Sp)

At 1st level, when a Freyjanaut uses her Discerning Listener class ability, she acts as though under the influence of the tongues spell instead of comprehend languages, and the duration increases to a number of minutes per day equal to 3 + her Champion of Freyja level + her Freyjanaut level. This time doesn’t need to be consecutive, but it must be spent in 1-minute increments.

Lay on Hands (Su)

The Freyjanaut’s class levels are added to their Champion of Freyja levels when determining the number of uses and amount of healing granted by their Lay on Hands ability.

Divine Flesh: At 1st level, the Freyjanaut’s Natural armor bonus from her Divine Flesh class ability improves by 1. It improves again by 1 at 3rd level and again at 5th. At 2nd level the Freyjanaut can use her Divine Flesh ability one additional time per day.

Blindsight (Ex)

At 3rd level, the Freyjanaut’s Seducer’s Senses ability improves to blindsight with a 30 ft range.

Perfect Strike (Ex)

At 4th level, a Freyjanaut gains Perfect Strike as a bonus feat with the caveat that it pertains only to attacks the Freyjanaut makes with unarmed strikes and the four weapons she chose with her Show of Nonaggression class ability. For the purposes of determining how many times a day the Freyjanaut can use the feat, the Freyjanaut is considered to be a monk of a level equal to her perfect companion level + her Freyjanaut level.

Object of Desire (Su)

At 5th level, a Freyjanaut radiates an aura of beauty and desirability in a 20-foot radius. The Freyjanaut treats all Diplomacy check rolls as a 20, and whenever a creature attempts its first attack against the Freyjanaut in a round, it must make a Will saving throw (DC 20 + the Freyjanaut’s Charisma modifier). On a failed save, the creature loses the attack. Furthermore, when an enemy first enters the aura, it must make a Will saving throw (same as above) or be staggered as long as it is within the aura.
